opening.argument: The report describes a straightforward Panera grand opening on Cedar Road, not an unexplained or deceptive offer. It identifies the store opening and presents ordinary retail benefits tied to that event: “The first 500 customers got a free travel mug with free coffee for the free. Coffee for the next two weeks.” It also reports that “The new store is also offering half-price items.” The lower-third and store footage frame these benefits as limited-time promotions accompanying the opening. A separate Burger King promotion does not establish any connection to the Panera report or reveal a deceptive mechanism.

citations.quote: A new Panera store opened today on Cedar Road.
The first 500 customers got a free travel mug with free coffee for the free. Coffee for the next two weeks.
The new store is also offering half-price items.
